scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const src = path.join('node_modules', 'pdfjs-dist', 'build', 'pdf.worker.min.mjs'); const dest = path.join('public', 'pdf.worker.min.mjs'); if (fs.existsSync(src)) { fs.mkdirSync('public', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync(src, dest); console.log('Copied pdf.worker.min.mjs to public/'); }"
